verdict.rationale: Governance is a fair question for an open-source web framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents who governs Next.js, whether a foundation or a single company. Mentions of Vercel templates and community complaints about Vercel lock-in are only indirect hints about deployment and hosting, not a documented governance or stewardship statement.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether the framework is governed by a foundation or a single company, so I can assess long-term continuity and lock-in risk
